label: Место
description: Declension of место (neuter, 'place / spot / seat') across the full case ladder, with the locative на месте vs. directional на место contrast and plural места́/мест.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative case. 1. 'Место' is the subject in its dictionary form. 2. 'Хорошее' is the neuter nominative adjective ending. 3. This is the baseline shape for naming a spot.

Strategic focus: Accusative case. 1. 'Место' is the direct object of 'нашёл'. 2. Neuter nouns show nominative=accusative syncretism, so the form is unchanged. 3. The case is read from its object role, not the ending.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 1. 'Нет' forces the genitive 'места'. 2. It marks the nonexistence of free space. 3. This is the standard 'there is no room' construction.
Strategic focus: Genitive case. 1. 'Хватает' governs the genitive 'места'. 2. It expresses an insufficient quantity of space. 3. This negated-availability pattern is common in everyday speech.

missions.phrase: Я медленно иду к месту встречи.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative case. 1. The preposition 'к' takes the dative 'месту'. 2. It marks the goal one is moving toward. 3. Dative is the case of direction toward with 'к'.
Strategic focus: Dative case. 1. 'Доверять' assigns the dative to its complement 'месту'. 2. 'Этому' agrees as neuter dative. 3. Certain verbs require the dative as their object.

Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 1. 'Доволен' governs the instrumental 'местом'. 2. 'Этим' agrees as neuter instrumental. 3. This adjective-plus-instrumental pattern expresses satisfaction with something.

Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 1. The preposition 'над' takes the instrumental 'местом'. 2. It locates one thing above another. 3. Spatial prepositions like 'над' fix position with the instrumental.

missions.phrase: Я уже на месте, жду тебя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case (location). 1. 'На месте' answers 'where' and means already arrived. 2. The prepositional ending marks static position. 3. Contrast this locative shape with directional 'на место'.

Strategic focus: Accusative case (motion). 1. 'На место' here takes the accusative for movement onto a spot. 2. It answers 'where to', not 'where'. 3. Same preposition 'на', different case, different meaning than 'на месте'.
Strategic focus: Genitive case. 1. The preposition 'с' takes the genitive 'места'. 2. It marks motion away from a spot. 3. 'С места' is the standard 'from one's seat' phrase.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 1. 'В' takes the prepositional 'месте' for static location. 2. 'Этом' agrees as neuter prepositional. 3. This pinpoints where a condition holds.

Strategic focus: Nominative with possessive. 1. 'Моё' is the neuter nominative possessive agreeing with 'место'. 2. The noun stays in its base form as predicate. 3. Possessives must match neuter gender.
Strategic focus: Nominative with agreement. 1. 'Рабочее' is the neuter nominative adjective for 'workplace'. 2. 'Моё' likewise agrees as neuter. 3. Both modifiers track the gender of 'место'.

missions.phrase: В зале ещё есть свободные места.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 1. 'Места́' is the plural of 'место' with end stress. 2. 'Свободные' is the plural adjective for free seats. 3. The plural reads from the -а ending and agreement.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 1. 'Места́' is the direct object of 'заняли'. 2. For this inanimate noun the accusative plural equals the nominative plural. 3. 'Все' agrees as plural.

missions.phrase: В автобусе больше нет свободных мест.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 1. 'Нет' triggers the genitive plural 'мест'. 2. This neuter noun drops the ending to a zero form in the genitive plural. 3. 'Свободных' agrees as plural genitive.
